document: Horizon One Tower BIM Execution Plan (BEP), Rev 3

requirements.notes: All fire doors must carry a confirmed fire rating (e.g. FD30, FD60) matching the approved fire strategy. A placeholder value carried over from an early design template is not acceptable for issue.
Every door must carry a Uniclass classification code so it can be scheduled and costed correctly.
Clear maintenance access dimensions must be recorded for facilities management planning.
Fire compartment walls must carry a confirmed fire resistance rating (e.g. REI 60, REI 90).
Plant requiring routine maintenance must record the clearance needed to service it.
Every mechanical asset must carry a Uniclass classification code for cost planning and the asset register.
Every room must carry a room classification code so areas can be scheduled correctly by use.

requirements.applies_to: rooms flagged as accessible facilities (e.g. accessible WCs)
requirements.notes: Rooms flagged as accessible facilities must have their clearance dimensions confirmed against the drawing set, not just modelled.
